title: VTC: fix participant data model (array→map or top-level type)
description: VTCParticipant is an embedded array on VTCCall. JMAP /set uses JSON Pointer paths for updates; array-index patching is fragile under concurrent joins/leaves. Either change participants from VTCParticipant[] to Id[VTCParticipant] (map keyed by participantId), or promote VTCParticipant to a top-level JMAP type with its own get/set/changes and a callId FK. Option B scales better for large calls. This blocks all participant operations (join, leave, mute, kick).
close_reason: Promoted VTCParticipant to top-level JMAP type with id, callId, kickedBy fields and full get/set/changes/query/queryChanges methods. Removed participants array from VTCCall, replaced with activeParticipantCount. Rewrote all participant operations to use VTCParticipant/set. Added reconnection semantics.
